```         
{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}

metrics1 <- read.csv("neuralbandit3_original_metrics_plain.csv")

ggplot(metrics1, aes(x = step, y = rolling_reward)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "NeuralBandit3: Rolling Reward Normal",
    x = "Training Steps",
    y = "Rolling Reward"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

metrics2 <- read.csv("neuralbandit3_original_metrics_conceptdrift.csv")

metrics2 <- metrics2 %>%
  arrange(step) %>%
  mutate(
    reward_change = rolling_reward - lag(rolling_reward),
    increasing = reward_change > 0,
    recovery_signal = increasing &
      lag(increasing, 1, default = FALSE) &
      lag(increasing, 2, default = FALSE)
  )

metrics2$drift_event <- as.logical(metrics2$drift_event)

drift_points <- metrics2 %>%
  filter(drift_event) %>%
  pull(step)

recovery_points2 <- data.frame()

for (d in drift_points) {
  recovery <- metrics2 %>%
    filter(step > d, recovery_signal == TRUE) %>%
    slice(1)
  
  if (nrow(recovery) > 0) {
    recovery_points2 <- bind_rows(
      recovery_points2,
      data.frame(
        drift_step = d,
        recovery_step = recovery$step,
        rolling_reward = recovery$rolling_reward
      )
    )
  }
}

ggplot(metrics2, aes(x = step, y = rolling_reward)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  # Concept drift
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = drift_points,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  # Recovery begins
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = recovery_points2$recovery_step,
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "blue",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "NeuralBandit3: Rolling Reward Concept Drift and Recovery",
    subtitle = "Red = concept drift | Blue = detected recovery",
    x = "Training Steps",
    y = "Rolling Reward"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
